source.primary_witnesses: Aramaic DSS Astronomical-Book fragments (4Q208-4Q211) where preserved; Ge'ez as fallback. NO continuous Greek witness for chs 72-82.
source.transliteration_convention: Aramaic Imperial-Aramaic per Milik 1976 + Tigchelaar-García Martínez DJD XXXVI 2000; Ge'ez SBL convention.
source.verificationStatus: best-effort reconstruction; verification pending against Milik 1976, Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000, Drawnel 2011, Neugebauer 1985.
source.fetchedFrom: Milik 1976 + Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000 DJD XXXVI + Drawnel 2011 + Black 1985 + Charles 1912 + Knibb 1978 + Nickelsburg-VanderKam 2012.
source.citation: Milik 1976; Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000; Drawnel 2011; Black 1985 (with Neugebauer 1985); Charles 1912 PD; Knibb 1978; Nickelsburg-VanderKam 2012.
source.paleography_note: CHAPTER 79 — SUMMARY of Uriel's revelation. Short chapter (~6 verses) closing the astronomical-revelation block. **4Q209 frag 26 may preserve fragmentary parallel to summary material.** Transitions to the oracle of cosmic disorder in ch 80.

verses.text_geez: ወይእዜሰ፡ ወልድየ፡ አርአይኩከ፡ ኵሎ፡ ወተፈጸመ፡ ኆለቆሙ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ለከዋክብት፡ ለሰማይ፡
verses.translit: wa-yəʾəzē-sa waldəya ʾarʾayku-ka kwəlo wa-tafaṣṣama ḫolaqomu la-kwəlu la-kawākəbt la-samāy
verses.notes: **Uriel addresses Enoch: 'Now, my son, I have shown you everything.'** Note the FILIAL-ADDRESS ('my son' / waldəya) — Uriel speaks to Enoch as a teacher to a disciple, matching the wisdom-instruction frame of late Second Temple literature. Cf. Sir 2:1; Prov 1:8.

verses.text_geez: ወአርአይኩከ፡ ኵሎ፡ ሕገገ፡ ለበበ፡ መዋዕል፡ ወለበበ፡ ሕግ፡ ወለበበ፡ ኵሉ፡ መንግሥት፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾarʾayku-ka kwəlo ḥəgaga laba-mawāʿəl wa-laba-ḥəg wa-laba-kwəlu mangəśt
verses.notes: Summary: 'I have shown you all the laws for every day, for every law, for every reign.'

verses.text_geez: ወዘንተ፡ ውእቱ፡ ሕጉ፡ ለወርኅ፡ ዘያመጽእ፡ ኆለቆሙ፡ ለበበ፡ ሐጋ፡ ለበበ፡ ቀዋምቱ፡ ለመንግሥቱ፡ በፍኖት፡ ቀዋሚ፡ ዘኮነ፡ ይትፌጸም፡ በበ፡ ወርኆሙ፡
verses.translit: wa-zanta wəʾətu ḥəggu la-warḫ zayāmaṣṣəʾ ḫolaqomu laba-ḥaggā laba-qawāmtu la-mangəśtu ba-fənot qawāmi zakona yətfēṣam baba warḫomu
verses.notes: **Closing law-formula for the moon.** Charles 1912 notes the Ge'ez is partially corrupt.

verses.text_geez: ወሕገገ፡ ለፀሐይ፡ ምስለ፡ መንበራቲሁ፡ ወምሥራቅ፡ ወምዕራብ፡ ስብአ፡ ዘያስተራኩም፡ ኆለቆ፡ ዘኵሉ፡ መንግሥቱ፡ ለፀሐይ፡
verses.translit: wa-ḥəgaga la-ḍaḥay məsla manbarātihu wa-məśrāq wa-məʿrāb səbʾa zayāstarākum ḫolaqo zakwəlu mangəśtu la-ḍaḥay

verses.text_geez: ወዝ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ነዊኅ፡ ይነግሕ፡ ወምዕራብ፡ ሐጺር፡ ይነግሕ፡ ወይትገብእ፡ መንበሮሙ፡ ለፀሐይ፡ ዘሕገገ፡ ዘይትኬለል፡ ኮነ፡ ለበበ፡ ጊዜሁ፡
verses.translit: wa-zə məśrāq nawiḫ yənaggəḥ wa-məʿrāb ḥaṣir yənaggəḥ wa-yətgabbəʾ manbaromu la-ḍaḥay zaḥəgaga zayətkēlal kona laba-gizēhu
verses.notes: Sun-circuit periodicity restated. Closing the astronomical-discourse block.

verses.text_geez: እሉ፡ መርሕተ፡ መዋዕልት፡ ኮኑ፡ ኆለቆሙ፡ ለሕገገ፡ ብርሃናት፡ ዘአርአየኒ፡ ኦሪኤል፡ ዘውእቱ፡ መርሐ፡ ኵሉ፡ ኆለቆሙ፡
verses.translit: ʾəllu marḥata mawāʿəlt konu ḫolaqomu la-ḥəgaga bərhānāt zaʾarʾayanī ʾUrʾēl zawəʾətu marḥa kwəlu ḫolaqomu
verses.notes: **FINAL ATTRIBUTION: Uriel as 'leader of all their reckonings.'** Closing colophon-style attribution. Sets up ch 80's transition to disorder.
